newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank says bought $45 million.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank says bought $45 million.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday the monetary authority is now a buyer of U.S. dollars after selling it heavily on Wednesday to quell peso speculation.
He said the Central Bank had bought about $45 million in the morning but declined to give the buying rate.
The Central Bank was also forced on Wednesday to increase its overnight borrowing rate by nine percentage points to 24 percent to defend the peso after Thailand's de facto devaluation.
Wednesday's turnover in the currency market surged to a record $1.05 billion, half of it in Central Bank deals -- mostly dollar selling.
